extracted.intended_audience: authors preparing manuscripts for Journal of Fluid Mechanics (LaTeX users)
extracted.subtask_description: Formatting and preparation rules (implemented as a LaTeX class) for manuscripts submitted to the Journal of Fluid Mechanics, including page layout, sectioning, equation numbering, title/author/abstract/keywords layout, citation style, theorem/proof formatting, and allowable class options.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allowed use / copyright
rubrics_metrics.description: This software may only be used in the preparation of journal articles or books or parts of books to be published by Cambridge University Press. Any other use constitutes an infringement of copyright.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors and users must not use the jfm.cls file for non-CUP publication purposes; report bugs to texsupport@aptaracorp.com.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class options and invocation
rubrics_metrics.description: Declared class options include oneside, twoside, draft, final, onecolumn, twocolumn, titlepage, notitlepage, leqno, fleqn, index, prodtf, referee, rapids. Default options executed: twoside, final, onecolumn.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select the appropriate class options (e.g., referee for referee format, rapids for JFM RAPIDS) when preparing the manuscript; options influence margins, draft behavior, and additional headers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Paper size and page layout
rubrics_metrics.description: Special papersize=174mm,247mm. Textheight set to 49 baselineskips plus topskip; textwidth 32pc; columnsep 10pt; margins and top/foot settings are defined (e.g., topmargin, oddsidemargin, evensidemargin).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Manuscripts must conform to the JFM page geometry implemented by the class: 174×247 mm page with the specified text area and margins—authors should use the class rather than attempting manual margin/font tweaks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Font sizes and families
rubrics_metrics.description:
Normal text size: 10pt (10.5pt if CUPmtlplainloaded). Definitions provided for 
ormalsize,  ootnotesize, 	iny, 	iny,  ig,  f, m, 	t,  f, 	extsf series etc.; special q-small/q-italic/q-bold commands.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the class defaults for font sizes and weights; do not override fonts to match JFM style—class selects appropriate math and text fonts and adjusts sizes for headings and body.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sectioning and heading styles
rubrics_metrics.description: Sections/subsections/subsubsections have specified spacing and font styling: section uses  ontswitch fseriesaggedright; subsection uses \normalsize\itshape\@raggedcenter; subsubsection uses \raggedright\normalsize\itshape. Section numbering depth set to 3.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors should rely on standard \section/\subsection/\subsubsection commands; the class enforces JFM typography and spacing for section headings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equation numbering and resetting
rubrics_metrics.description: Equations are numbered by section: \theequation is defined as \thesection.\arabic{equation}. The class resets equation counter at each \section (see section handling code).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Equation labels will appear as section.number (e.g., 2.3). Use the class's subequations environment for grouped equation lettering (a, b, ...).

rubrics_metrics.name: Subequations and subeqnarray behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides CUPsubequations (subeqn.sty style) and subeqnarray adaptations: subequation counter is alphabetic for subequation labels; \slabel writes labels in line with modified LATEX.LTX behavior.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To produce labeled subequations (a), (b), etc., use the provided subequations/subeqnarray environments; the class ensures correct labeling and referencing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Abstract environment formatting
rubrics_metrics.description: The abstract environment is defined to produce normal text size, no indent, and ends with a centered rule (30pc wide) after a small vertical skip.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Place the manuscript abstract inside \begin{abstract} ... \end{abstract}; the class will format it with appropriate spacing and the separating rule.

rubrics_metrics.name: Keywords environment and label
rubrics_metrics.description: A keywords environment exists which begins with a bold "Key words:" label and normal size text; it ends with the same centered rule (except in rapids mode) and spacing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supply keywords using \begin{keywords} ... \end{keywords}; the class will print the 'Key words:' label and format the keywords as required by JFM.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title, author, affiliation and history macros
rubrics_metrics.description: Macros provided: \title, \author, \affiliation, \shorttitle, \shortauthor, \maketitle, and history alignment with (Received xx; revised xx; accepted xx). \affiliation{...} sets affiliation content; \maketitle prints title, (lowercased) authors, affiliation, and history.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors must use the class macros to provide title/author/affiliation and the received/revised/accepted history fields; the class will produce the formatted title block and short author/title for headers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Journal citation block / DOI formatting
rubrics_metrics.description: Macros \journal, \doi, \volume, \pagerange, \pubyear are provided. \doi sets \@doi (prefix 10.1017/). \@journal and \@underjournal produce the J. Fluid Mech. citation box used in page headers or titlepages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide DOI, volume, page range, and pubyear via the provided macros if requested; the class formats the journal citation block in the style of J. Fluid Mech.

rubrics_metrics.name: Natbib citation punctuation and bibliography hooks
rubrics_metrics.description: At begin document the class loads natbib and sets \bibpunct{(}{)}{;}{a}{}{,}. It globally redefines thebibliography to JFMthebib when natbib is loaded.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use author-year citations via natbib; the class enforces JFM punctuation and bibliography environment naming—use provided bibliography style or follow the class's expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Theorem and proof styling
rubrics_metrics.description: Theorem environment headers use small-caps for the theorem name and italic body. Proof environment prints an italic 'Proof.' label and ends with a proof box symbol; definitions for unnumbered/starred theorem forms are provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Define theorems via the class's theorem macros (\@xnthm etc.) and use the proof environment to get the correct 'Proof.' label and end-of-proof mark per JFM style.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lists and item labels
rubrics_metrics.description: Itemize/enumerate/description environments are adapted: item label symbols for different levels are set (bullet, circle, dash variants); enumerate uses roman/alpha/roman sequencing; descriptionlabel is bold; indentation parameters are tuned.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use standard list environments; the class sets label symbols, numbering style and indentation to match JFM publication conventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Float and figure placement parameters
rubrics_metrics.description: Float spacing parameters are set (\floatsep 10pt plus/minus, \textfloatsep 12pt plus 6pt, \@fptop, \@fpsep, \@fpbot, dblfloat spacing variants) and \special papersize with pdf page width/height set.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid manual float spacing adjustments; rely on the class to position floats according to JFM layout rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Titlepage and page style for RAPIDS
rubrics_metrics.description: If rapids option is set, special header (JFM RAPIDS) and different title/author/affiliation alignment/formatting are applied (put@rapidsHead and related macros).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When preparing submissions intended for JFM RAPIDS use the rapids class option so the class applies the RAPIDS-specific title formatting and header rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix behavior and numbering
rubrics_metrics.description: The \appendix macro sets \thesection to letters (A, B, ...), resets equation counters, and changes equation numbering to section.equation (with new section letter).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use \appendix to start appendices so the class correctly renumbers sections and equations per JFM conventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Table of contents and contents heading
rubrics_metrics.description: The table of contents name is set to 'CONTENTS' and \tableofcontents centers a small-caps heading and starts the toc with depth two by default.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If including a TOC, the class will format it with the 'CONTENTS' heading and default tocdepth; authors generally do not need to adjust these settings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Index and index name
rubrics_metrics.description: Index environment uses section* named 'Index' and adds it to the toc; index formatting and item spacing are defined.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use theindex environment or appropriate indexing packages; the class provides the expected heading and formatting for an index.
